scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: How about an app called M1GPS that uses location info to play shiritori with place names? A game where you play shiritori using the names of places around your current location.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Shiritori with place names... that sounds fun! But I feel like I’ve heard something like that before...

scenarios.speaker: Senior Nyama
scenarios.text: Hey, {{playerName}}! That’s the M1GPS idea I proposed last year! Don’t go stealing it!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Oh... crap. I totally forgot. That was the idea N’yama came up with last year...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Ah, sorry! That was yours, wasn’t it, Senpai... I completely forgot.

scenarios.speaker: Senior Nyama
scenarios.text: Seriously... copying ideas...........................isn’t cool, you know.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: But thanks to you, {{playerName}}-senpai, I’ve got some ideas now too! Thank you♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan covered for me... she’s so kind. But man, what an embarrassing mistake.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Looking annoyed, Senior Nyama left the lab. As an awkward silence lingered, Megumi cheerfully continued the conversation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Let’s work hard to create an original app of our own! Oh, and {{playerName}}-senpai... I’m a total beginner at programming, so where should I even start?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: What advice would you give to beginner programmer Megumi?

options.text: Just have Claude Code write it for you
Let’s define the requirements thoroughly and then build it
Start by copying programming syntax by hand to learn the basics
